label: kizuna_dragon_a_02
text: I have a question for you. Do you find my class\ndifficult?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_03
text: Hmm... Perhaps I need to improve how I convey\nthe material.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_04
text: That is certainly good to hear.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_06
text: You chose to take on the Gyms as part of your\nTreasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_07
text: That must mean you like Pokémon battles. Is that\ncorrect?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_08a
text: One naturally becomes skilled at doing what they\nenjoy. That must be why you are so strong.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_08b
text: Then you’re attempting to overcome a weakness?\nI applaud your efforts, indeed![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_10
text: Ah, do forgive me for springing such an odd\nquestion upon you so suddenly.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_11
text: I often find myself pondering the nature of\nstrength these days...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_12
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Anyway, thank you again for your input,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_a_system_01
text: You became slightly closer with Mr. Hassel!
